instruction.text: Ordne jeder Frage die passende Antwort zu.

atoms.a: What do you want to be?
Where do you want to live?
Why do you want to live there?
What do you want to own?

instruction.text: Ergänze die Sätze, indem du das passende Wort auswählst.

atoms.b: My best friend and I want to be ((++stars gardeners)) with lots of fans. We want to be so ((++famous funny)) that everyone knows our names and the paparazzi take photos of us.
atoms.sound: My best friend and I want to be stars with lots of fans. We want to be so famous that everyone knows our names and the paparazzi take photos of us.

atoms.b: I want to be a millionaire. I want to be so ((++rich poor)) that I can buy several cars and a villa with a ((++pool desk)).
atoms.sound: I want to be a millionaire. I want to be so rich that I can buy several cars and a villa with a pool.

atoms.b: I want to travel the ((++world city)) and visit all seven continents. I don't only want to see new ((++places malls)) but also meet new people and get to know different cultures.

instruction.text: Vervollständige den Dialog zwischen Nour und ihren Freund:innen.

atoms.a: Wo wollt ihr in der Zukunft leben?
atoms.b: Where do you want to ((++live learn)) in the future?
atoms.sound: Where do you want to live in the future?

atoms.b: I want to live in a ((++city village)) like London, New York or Paris because there is so much to see and do. It never gets ((++boring exiting)) in a big city.
atoms.sound: I want to live in a city like London, New York or Paris because there is so much to see and do. It never gets boring in a big city.

atoms.b: Unlike you, I want to live in the countryside because I love ((++nature skyscrapers)) and I hate crowded places. Maybe I'll ((++move meet)) to a rural area of Scotland or Iceland after school.
atoms.sound: Unlike you, I want to live in the countryside because I love nature and I hate crowded places. Maybe I'll move to a rural area of Scotland or Iceland after school.

atoms.b: I don't want to live in one place for a long period of time. I want to buy a caravan and ((++travel stay)) from one city to another. Maybe I'll ((++visit talk)) you both for a couple of weeks.
